origin: Generalized from the Frontier Weave supervised harness hybrid (frontier-routing/v1).

supervised_hybrid.description: A frontier Claude or Codex coordinator defines the semantic oracle, freezes a mechanical task packet with discriminating gates, dispatches one disposable OpenCode worker loop, runs cold deterministic gates, and reviews the captured diff. The worker holds no correctness-definition, Git, sprintctl, deployment, or acceptance authority.

frontier_only.description: The coordinator harness owns planning, implementation, verification, and review without a bulk worker.

authority: semantic oracle and falsifying acceptance-property design
edit files inside writable_patch_paths within its own worktree
denied_authority: session lifecycle, terminal settlement, or publication

coordinator_plan.purpose: Architecture, ambiguity resolution, dependency ordering, and packet construction.

coordinator_review.purpose: Wave review, failure classification, and corrected retry packets.

mechanical_bulk.purpose: Low-ambiguity implementation against frozen interfaces, an externally supplied oracle, and coordinator-authored gates that deterministically fail for every relevant unmet requirement.

bindery_external_runtime_w0.purpose: Project-scoped mechanical implementation for bindery-core external-runtime W0 beneath frozen coordinator-authored interfaces and tests.

bounded_semantic.purpose: Behaviourally coupled implementation with frozen interfaces but meaningful semantic uncertainty. Production remains coordinator-owned; Kimi K2.7 is an assessment experiment only.

adversarial_verification.purpose: Test-oracle, parity-fixture, mutation, falsifiability, and cross-layer behavioural-proof design.

architecture_authority.purpose: Architecture, authority, compatibility, release, migration, recovery, and materially underspecified work.

worker_failure.purpose: Any semantic rejection, missing oracle, packet contradiction, inability to execute a focused gate, repeated reading without mutation, or authority-boundary discovery returns to the coordinator. GLM has no assigned production role.

k3_benchmark.purpose: Benchmark-only read-only model surface for a separately approved hypothesis; no production authority.

required_before_dispatch: packet references an existing sprintctl item in a startable state
the coordinator holds the sprintctl claim for that item
architecture, acceptance criteria, and non-goals are settled
task_class is mechanical_implementation and risk is low
the semantic oracle is externally defined by the coordinator and the worker cannot modify it
each relevant requirement has a coordinator-authored deterministic acceptance property naming a registered command and the incorrect behaviour it falsifies
writable_patch_paths are inside the repository manifest scope.allowed_path_roots
no writable path intersects the repository hybrid.protected_paths
every registered command runs green cold in the disposable worktree before inference
the exact repository payload and worker model are operator-approved
route_to_coordinator_instead: worker would need to invent or modify the test oracle
test, parity fixture, or adversarial verification is the primary deliverable
security, credential, authority, release, compatibility, migration, or recovery semantics
changes smaller than the packet overhead
any rejected worker attempt unless the coordinator authors a materially revised packet

qualification.admission: Vuoro ecosystem tooling is admitted only for low-ambiguity mechanical implementation with frozen interfaces, an externally supplied oracle, and executable discriminating gates. Test-oracle design, parity fixtures, cross-layer behavioural proof, and authority/release/compatibility/migration/recovery decisions remain coordinator-only. Every packet still requires a live coordinator claim, captured execution evidence, independent review, and human acceptance.
